safety.mpn: OMRON A22E-M-01 emergency stop 40 mm red, 1 NC
safety.notes: Its NC contact sits in the motor supply (VBAT to the driver's VM, through the board's e-stop connector): pressing it opens the motors' supply at once, the controller stays on (Eurobot F.4.c tolerates that). Motor current keeps the contact above its 10 mA minimum load; a logic-level sense line (0.3 mA) would sit under it.
